caption: The drawing, created in grayscale pencil or ink on a light, off-white background, depicts a single pair of ornate tongs placed horizontally across the center of the page. Each arm of the tongs terminates in a scallop shell-shaped grip. The handles are decorated; on the outer handle, there is an engraved or embossed design resembling a vase or urn with flowers or foliage emerging from it. The tongs show some shadowing underneath to indicate their three-dimensional shape. Toward the bottom right corner of the composition, the names "WALTON, KALAMIAN" are written in capital letters. The space surrounding the tongs is empty, highlighting the object as the focal point of the drawing.
title: Silver Sugar Tongs
